definitions.LIQUIDATED: Recovered kernel liquidation event occurred this transition; may be terminal.
definitions.MAX_HOLDING_FORCED_EXIT: Recovered environment-owned time_stop closed the position at max_holding_bars; episode itself need not terminate.
definitions.TERMINATED: Kernel entered another terminal state, currently max_drawdown/risk-limit path in recovered semantics.
definitions.TRUNCATED: External time/resource horizon requested after this physical transition; not an MDP terminal cause.

final_pre_reset_preservation: snapshot_t1 and account_observation_t1 are emitted before any reset. step_account never resets automatically.
post_end_step_policy: Stepping a terminated or truncated snapshot fails closed; caller must invoke explicit_reset.
